component.name: Pebble
component.summary: A beautiful GPU-accelerated terminal for Linux

description.p: Pebble is a Linux-focused terminal emulator with a unified tab and title bar, the Pebble Quartz color scheme, hyperlinks, ligatures, tabs and split panes.
Configuration is expressed using Lua and remains fully customizable.
A very long list of improvements to performance and resource utilization as well as new features. The changelog has a complete list!
